name: longhaul
description: Makes your Claude Code week last: compacts between tasks, hands plan steps to Sonnet, shows the pace you can afford.

guard_mode.title: Guard mode
guard_mode.description: Compacts the conversation between tasks once it passes the soft limit, and at the end of a turn once it passes the hard limit. auto acts, ask asks first, off does nothing.

classifier_mode.title: Classifier mode
classifier_mode.description: Hands execution work (plan steps, mechanical edits, searches) to a Sonnet subagent and has Opus review the result. auto acts, ask has Claude ask first, off does nothing.

budget_mode.title: Budget mode
budget_mode.description: The meter above the prompt: context size, weekly use, and today against the pace that lasts until the reset. auto shows it, off hides it.

health_mode.title: Health mode
health_mode.description: Checks once per session what every session loads before any work (MCP tools, memory files, skills) and mentions it above the prompt at most once a week. /longhaul health always works. auto shows the heads-up, off hides it.

soft_limit.title: Soft limit (tokens)
soft_limit.description: Context size, in tokens, after which the guard compacts at the next safe moment between tasks.

hard_limit.title: Hard limit (tokens)
hard_limit.description: Context size, in tokens, after which the guard compacts at the end of the turn, even mid-task. Must be higher than the soft limit.

rules_file.title: Rules file
rules_file.description: Absolute path to a JSON file of classifier rules that replaces the built-in ones. Empty uses the built-in rules.
